scope: read-only gap audit for Member list and Member Detail

observed_coverage.important_limit: Opening a tab proves its initialization requests only; it does not prove every filter, pagination, export, secondary action, or write branch inside that tab.

classification_corrections.reason: The shared inventory documents the same path as GET, while FAT UI actually uses POST with a CBOR body. This is method/document drift, not an absent documented path.
The shared inventory documents the same path as GET, while the Member Detail token-wallet tab actually uses POST.

They still mark current-run UID waiting and some Risk Control/Convert to Agent branches as blocked, but newer write-flow evidence proves Risk Control was restored and Convert to Agent was executed terminally. Use record-flow-member-write-action-endpoint.csv as the newer truth.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: Use current filters or the current-run member filter; download may be captured without preserving member rows.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Set a bounded filter, click Export, capture response headers/status and delete the local download after structural inspection.

gaps.control: Batch query and remaining filter families
gaps.legal_prerequisite: Use only synthetic current-run account identifiers and valid select values from the UI.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Probe Batch query, one value from each select family, page 2, and a changed page size. Do not count each filter as a new endpoint; record parameter-source coverage.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: Allocate a dedicated synthetic account/email/phone that is not used by another lane; preserve the created target reference before submission.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Create this additional lane before terminal password/agent/VIP operations so it can be used for later state-specific controls.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: Current-run approved member, wallet baseline, small bounded amount, valid reason and approval TOTP.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Credit a small amount, verify wallet and adjustment ledger, debit the same amount, then verify exact restoration. Run before turnover-clear or terminal operations.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: Current-run member, token-wallet baseline, small bounded token amount, valid reason and approval TOTP.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Top up, verify token ledger, withdraw the identical amount, and verify restoration; do not use Reset/Clear until all reversible checks are complete.

gaps.control: 流水要求调整: 增加 / 扣除 / 清零
gaps.legal_prerequisite: Exact zero/non-zero turnover baseline, one explicitly selected game or bounded game group, small amount, reason and approval TOTP.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Increase on one game, verify detail, deduct the same amount and verify restoration. Execute Clear only last and only on requirements created by this flow.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: Current-run member; ideally run after the reversible turnover pair so the result is non-empty.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Open after turnover add/sub and capture type lookup, list parameters, pagination and response structure.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: A current-run member whose saved baseline is Withdraw=Forbidden and a valid approval TOTP.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Because the baseline is Forbidden, unlock temporarily, prove Allowed, then lock again and prove the original Forbidden baseline.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: Current-run member, exact risk-tag/level baseline, reversible option, reason and approval TOTP if requested.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Open and map the form first. Execute only if the same UI supplies a deterministic restoration value. Do not confuse this endpoint with Details-page Risk Control, which used POST /admin/member/update.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: Dedicated current-run member below the desired VIP level; original/manual level captured. The documented endpoint is upgrade-only, so downgrade recovery must not be assumed.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Probe visibility/form on the new lane. If only upgrade exists, execute once as a terminal operation after all balance, turnover and token checks.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: Keep the route-injected current-run UID and bounded date range; do not persist downloaded member data.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Scan Deposit, Withdrawal, Bonus, XP, Token, Daily Statistics, then both Login Log versions. Treat /admin/log/export as UNDOCUMENTED_ACTIVE only if Network proves it.

gaps.control: Query, Reset, filters and pagination inside each opened tab
gaps.legal_prerequisite: Current-run member and valid UI filter values; expand time only enough to obtain representative data.
gaps.recommended_sequence: For each tab, exercise one meaningful filter combination plus pagination where available; reuse the already proven endpoint classification and add parameter origins.
Click once and determine whether it is a filter/preset, modal, or independent request. Do not invent a count endpoint from the label.

gaps.control: Record-row state action when a current-run purchase exists
gaps.legal_prerequisite: A free-spin purchase created by the current flow; record its baseline and prove a reversible state transition.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Do not manufacture historical data. Scan only if the client thread creates a qualifying current-run record.

gaps.control: Reset Login Password / list Reset Password
gaps.legal_prerequisite: Dedicated terminal member and a valid member notification verification code; original password cannot be restored.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Execute only after that member is no longer needed for client-side login or other recoverable scans.

gaps.page: Member and Member Detail / inviter transfer
gaps.control: Transfer and changed / 转移代理线
gaps.legal_prerequisite: Proven current-run member and valid current-run inviter/agent relationship, with the original upline captured and an accepted restoration path.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Defer until ordinary Member scanning is complete. The two UI forms likely represent different transfer semantics and must be captured separately.

gaps.control: Contextual pencil/edit icons for editable member fields
gaps.legal_prerequisite: Use a reversible current-run member and capture exact field label/value before opening each edit modal.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Inventory icons by surrounding description label, not coordinates or ordinal indexes; map nickname/email or other editable fields separately and restore each value immediately.

gaps.legal_prerequisite: A transaction/turnover record created by this flow and positively selected by the UI; irreversible source requirements must not belong to unrelated data.
gaps.recommended_sequence: Run last, only after Network distinguishes the two documented clear paths and the selected target is current-run-owned.

recommended_execution_order: Member list filters, pagination, Batch query and Export
Create one additional synthetic Member lane via Add Member
Credit -> ledger/wallet verification -> equal Debit -> baseline verification
Token top-up -> ledger verification -> equal withdrawal -> baseline verification
Turnover increase -> detail verification -> equal deduct -> change-log verification
Withdraw limitation Unlock -> Lock baseline restoration
Risk Control Adjustment form and reversible branch
All record-tab exports and meaningful query/pagination variants
Conditional free-spin record action only if current-run data exists
VIP manual adjustment as a terminal member operation
Password reset as a terminal member operation
Inviter/agent transfers after ordinary Member coverage is complete
Turnover Clear/Reset actions last and only on current-run-created requirements
